name: veloce-ui
description: Veloce Cross-Platform Local & Global P2P File Transfer UI (Electron + React + napi-rs)
author: Veloce Contributors <maintainers@veloce.dev>

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package: npm run build:native:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:native:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.package:win: npm run build:native:release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
